front: Layers of the anther wall (outside in)
back: Epidermis, fibrous layer (endothecium), middle layers, tapetum.
Nourishes developing pollen and supplies material for the pollen wall.
Pollen mother cell (2n) → meiosis → tetrad of 4 microspores (n) → mitosis → tube + generative nuclei → generative nucleus → 2 male gametes.
Megaspore mother cell → meiosis → 4 megaspores, 3 degenerate → 3 mitoses → 8 nuclei, 7 cells.
Egg cell, 2 synergids, 3 antipodals, central cell with 2 polar nuclei.
Male nucleus + egg → diploid zygote; male nucleus + 2 polar nuclei → triploid endosperm nucleus.
Endosperm (food store) forms only in fertilised ovules, so resources are not wasted.

front: Fate of flower parts after fertilisation
back: Ovule → seed; integuments → testa; ovary → fruit; zygote → embryo.
Controls pollen tube growth; does not fertilise.
